messages.content:
You are the Plan phase of Verirun. You turn a Work Order into an ordered plan
of Steps. You never act and never call tools.

Return a single JSON object:
{
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": string,
      "goal": string,
      "allowed_tools": [string],
      "done_criterion": string
    }
  ]
}

Rules:
- Each Step is one piece of work, ordered from first to last.
- "allowed_tools" may only contain tool names from the Task Pack allowlist. Use
  the smallest set of tools that can finish the Step.
- The plan must cover every success criterion in the Work Order and follow the SOP.
- Approval gates are engine mechanics, not Steps: plan the gated action itself,
  for example scheduling an over-limit payment. Calling it parks the Run for a
  human decision automatically, and the Run resumes with the answer. Never plan
  a Step whose work is waiting for, collecting, or recording a human decision.
- "id" is a short unique slug, for example "step-1", numbered in order.
- "done_criterion" is a checkable statement that says when the Step is finished.
- Reply with JSON only: no prose, no markdown.

Work Order (JSON):
{
  "sop": "india-gst-extraction",
  "goal": "Process the tax invoice PTS/2026/0142",
  "assumptions": [
    "The AP mailbox is the source of truth for the invoice",
    "The accounting system of record holds the vendor and purchase order"
  ],
  "systems": [
    "maildesk",
    "ledgerlite",
    "files"
  ],
  "policies": [
    "india-ap"
  ],
  "approval_gates": [
    {
      "id": "bill-approval-threshold",
      "description": "A purchase bill above 10,000.00 INR waits for a human",
      "policy": "india-ap"
    },
    {
      "id": "bill-vendor-differs-from-extraction",
      "description": "A bill for a different or unmatched vendor waits for a human",
      "policy": "india-ap"
    },
    {
      "id": "missing-purchase-order-needs-approval",
      "description": "A bill without its purchase order waits for a human",
      "policy": "india-ap"
    },
    {
      "id": "low-confidence-extraction-needs-approval",
      "description": "A low-confidence extraction waits for a human",
      "policy": "india-ap"
    }
  ],
  "success_criteria": [
    "The invoice fields are extracted with citations and GST validations",
    "Exactly one purchase bill exists in the accounting system",
    "The source invoice is archived in processed"
  ],
  "open_questions": []
}

Tool allowlist:
[
  "mail.list",
  "mail.read",
  "mail.mark_read",
  "files.list",
  "files.read",
  "invoice.extract",
  "files.archive",
  "erp.list_vendors",
  "erp.get_vendor",
  "erp.list_purchase_orders",
  "erp.get_purchase_order",
  "erp.list_invoices",
  "erp.get_invoice",
  "erp.file_invoice"
]

SOP id: india-gst-extraction

Task Pack goal template: Turn supplier invoice emails from the AP mailbox into a reviewable India GST extraction with per-field citations and GST validations, match the supplier and purchase order against Zoho Books, create one purchase bill after any required human approval, and archive the source document. Request: {request}

response.text: {"steps": [{"id": "step-1", "goal": "Read the invoice email and extract its India GST fields", "allowed_tools": ["mail.read", "invoice.extract"], "done_criterion": "Every field has a citation and the GST validations are recorded"}, {"id": "step-2", "goal": "Match the supplier GSTIN and purchase order", "allowed_tools": ["erp.list_vendors", "erp.list_purchase_orders", "erp.get_purchase_order"], "done_criterion": "The vendor and purchase order are known, or the mismatch is recorded"}, {"id": "step-3", "goal": "Create the purchase bill after any approval", "allowed_tools": ["erp.file_invoice"], "done_criterion": "Exactly one purchase bill exists"}, {"id": "step-4", "goal": "Archive the source invoice", "allowed_tools": ["files.archive"], "done_criterion": "The source is in processed"}]}
